title: Crazy Taxi/Drivers
text:
Axel
left

Axel is a free spirited punk who loves the ladies. He became a cabbie because he feels it is a stylish profession.

Gena
left

Gena is a gearhead with a need for speed. She chose to become a cabbie because she finds it more interesting to weave through traffic than loop around a track.

B.D. Joe
left

Despite being a talented entertainer B.D. Joe has chosen to become a cabbie rather than attempt to perform professionally. He loves to make people's day and finds his work too enjoyable to give up.

Gus
left

When Gus was younger he was rowdy and obsessed with being the best. He pioneered the "crazy" style when he bought his 1955 Jalopy. As Gus got older his personality became more relaxed by learning the value of strategy through gambling.
